Row.Text: [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]World wonder[ENDCOLOR] — only one may exist in the world. Building it [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]opens the commodity market for ALL civilizations[ENDCOLOR]. Its owner earns [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]+25%[ENDCOLOR] above market price on their own commodity sales, and skims a [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]2%[ENDCOLOR] cut of every civilization's commodity trade volume each turn.

A Commodity Exchange is a marketplace where raw materials are bought and sold at prices set by global supply and demand. By formalizing this market, a civilization can extract maximum value from its natural resource surplus.

Build the Commodity Exchange in a resource-rich city. It pays off most when you control strategic resources that other civilizations need — high global demand pushes prices up, and your 25% bonus amplifies the windfall.

Set.Text: Allows you to build the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Windmill[ENDCOLOR] in cities built on flat land, increasing [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Commodity Exchange:[ENDCOLOR] Lets you build the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Commodity Exchange[ENDCOLOR] world wonder. Once ANY civilization builds it, the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Commodity Market[ENDCOLOR] opens for everyone (Additional Information menu): sell surplus [ICON_PRODUCTION] strategic and [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] luxury resources for recurring [ICON_GOLD] Gold, and import what you lack, at floating supply-and-demand prices. The wonder's owner earns +25% on its own sales plus a cut of all trade volume.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Sovereign Bonds:[ENDCOLOR] Unlocks the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Sovereign Bonds[ENDCOLOR] market, where you buy the bonds of other civilizations you have met for a [ICON_GOLD] Gold coupon every turn. Distressed nations pay higher yields and trade at a discount, but can restructure or default.
